title: The Opposite house across the road
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：opposite　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 opposite 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the keeper wrote of ① an opposite house across the road in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② so opposite that nobody in the tower would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the opposite ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the opposite house across the road that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too opposite to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the opposite ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an opposite view of the matter, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as opposite as the view of the matter they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was opposite or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something opposite, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite opposite; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the opposite ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, before dawn, she wrote of another opposite house across the road in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less opposite than anybody had expected. ⑩ The opposite view of the matter that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the opposite ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 对面（前置定语 an opposite house across the road：1965 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件对面的房子）
B. adj. 对面／相反（两处加强说法：so opposite that … 与 no less opposite than …）
C. adj. 对面／相反（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 对面（表语 too opposite to do：母亲觉得它太对面，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 相反（前置定语 an opposite view of the matter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩相反的看法）
F. adj. 相反（同级比较 as opposite as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对事情相反的看法相比）
G. adj. 相反（后置定语 something opposite：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 相反（受程度副词修饰 quite opposite：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: an opposite house across the road
the opposite house across the road that
an opposite view of the matter
The opposite view of the matter that

answers.why: opposite 意为“对面”，1965 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件对面的房子”，此处作前置定语 an opposite house across the road。
opposite 意为“对面”，此处用 so opposite that 结构，说它对面到钟楼里没人敢靠近。
opposite 意为“对面”，年历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的对面路对面的房子，等于最高级的说法。
opposite 意为“对面”，母亲认为这件东西“太对面了，谁也用不上”，too opposite to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
opposite 意为“相反”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩相反的看法”，此处作前置定语 an opposite view of the matter。
opposite 意为“相反”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对事情相反的看法一样相反”，同级比较用 as opposite as。
opposite 意为“相反”，年历上那半行字要的是“相反的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something opposite。
opposite 意为“相反”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当相反”，quite 修饰原级 opposite。
opposite 意为“相反”，no less opposite than 表示“其相反不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之相反不亚于任何人的预料。
opposite 意为“相反”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的相反看法”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件对面的房子。（an opposite house across the road）
它对面到钟楼里没有一个人敢靠近。（so opposite that …）
母亲觉得它太对面，谁也用不上。（too opposite to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩相反的看法。（an opposite view of the matter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对事情相反的看法一样相反。（as opposite as …）
到了 1972 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件相反的东西。（something opposite）
answers: In 1965 the keeper wrote of an opposite house across the road in the calendar.
It was so opposite that nobody in the tower would go near it.
My mother thought it too opposite to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an opposite view of the matter.
He said nobody would call it as opposite as the view of the matter they had once had.
By 1972 the calendar asked for nothing but something opposite.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 opposite 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the keeper wrote of an opposite house across the road in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the opposite house across the road that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too opposite to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an opposite view of the matter, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite opposite, and everybody laughed.
The opposite ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
